summary: Deep Analytics v1.13.14 end-to-end tested. Backend: all 4 endpoints PASS (4/4 pytest, 100%). Product endpoint remains healthy (regression). New service/competition/social-post endpoints return the correct shape (product, kpis, top_visitors, buyers, shares_by_platform, reviews, comparison, monthly_series, traffic_sources) and satisfy every KPI requirement: service total_views=507 with add_to_cart(bookings)=14 and total_revenue=2000.0 (>0 because bookings expose total_fee), competition total_views=130, add_to_cart(participants)=26, capacity_pct=26.0, and post likes_total=3150, shares_total=486, engagement_score=4618, reach_estimate=16555. Frontend: all 4 UI flows PASS via /merchant/{service|competition|post|product}-analytics?id=... Hero pills render correctly per kind (خدمة / مسابقة / منشور / جديد), all Arabic KPI labels match the spec (مشاهدات الخدمة / الحجوزات NOT أضيف للسلة / حجوزات ملغاة / خدمات مكتملة / إيرادات الخدمة for services; مشاهدات المسابقة / مسجلون / أماكن شاغرة / مشاركات فعلية / قيمة المشتريات / نسبة الامتلاء plus 🏆 X/Y فائز winners badge for competitions; الوصول / المعجبون / تعليقات / مشاركات المنشور / نقاط التفاعل / معدل التفاعل plus وصول~N reach badge for posts). Funnel labels verified for all three new kinds (حجز خدمة/بدأ التنفيذ/تم إنجاز الخدمة, سجّل مشاركته/أكمل المتطلبات/دخل السحب, أعجبوا/علّقوا/شاركوا). All six tabs render (نظرة عامة, الزوار, [الحجوزات|المشاركون|المشاركات], [المشاركات|—|—], التقييمات, مقارنة) and the compare tab correctly renders 'مقارنة بخدمات مشابهة' / 'مقارنة بمسابقات أخرى' / 'مقارنة بمنشورات أخرى'. Live-preview section tabs (المتجر, الصيانة, المسابقات, السوشيال ميديا, العام) load correctly, confirming wiring at live-preview.tsx:91-93 works. No red screens, no broken images, no console errors beyond pre-existing shadow*/resizeMode deprecation warnings.

minor.issue: Fallback amplification in views KPI (bookings*6) may over-inflate 'total_views' when the service_views collection is empty. Same fallback logic exists for competitions (participants*5) and posts (max heuristic). Values look reasonable for demo data but consider gating behind a flag if real analytics traffic starts flowing.

'total_revenue' is computed as spend_requirement * participants. If future competitions have zero spend_requirement (free draws), total_revenue will be 0 even when participants>0. Consider surfacing an explicit revenue field vs implied. Reference: /app/backend/deep_analytics.py:361.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated style props 'shadow*' and 'style.resizeMode' emit warnings on every screen (pre-existing, not introduced by v1.13.14). Reference: console logs during navigation.

action_items: None blocking — all 4 endpoints and all 4 frontend flows pass. Consider tightening the demo fallback amplification for total_views once real telemetry is wired.
Optional: add testID attributes to product-analytics.tsx (KPI cards, tab buttons, hero pill) so future regressions can be selector-driven instead of Arabic-text-driven.
critical_code_review_comments: product-analytics.tsx is 605 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. The kind-aware refactor is well done (single component driven by props), but consider extracting the KPI/funnel label maps and StyleSheet to a separate module.
deep_analytics.py correctly excludes MongoDB _id in all payloads and consistently reuses the 'product' key for UI compatibility.

The 'add_to_cart' KPI is overloaded to mean bookings/participants/likes depending on kind. The frontend maps this correctly via labelSet, but backend consumers of the raw JSON might be confused — a comment or an alias field (e.g., 'primary_engagement') would help future readers.
No testIDs anywhere in product-analytics.tsx or live-preview.tsx — all interactive elements rely on Arabic text selectors for automated testing.
server.py still 6350+ lines; deep_analytics correctly split into its own module — same pattern should be applied to the monolith.
